{{Quote|Welcome to Macula Station, gateway to the Belsavis penal colonies. Feel free to ask me about our correctional facilities.|O5-D6|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''05-D6''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was stationed on the [[Macula Station]] above [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]], where he gave information about the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] to the newly-arrived and authorized personnel.<ref name="TOR" />
